protocol.rationale: Expanded labels alone did not improve LeFood Change MAE (9.75 vs 9.63). Test a model that separates recorded zero mass from the amount in positive-mass records. Labels are source weights, not food-presence annotations.
protocol.scope: Adaptive development follow-up; outer datasets already examined; independent confirmation required.
protocol.budgets: Original 50-label folds and the expanded folds frozen in data-budget.json
protocol.classifier: Group-weighted kernel ridge fit to target fraction > 0 using After features, clipped to [0,1] as an uncalibrated regression score
protocol.positive_model: Group-weighted kernel ridge fit on positive-mass training records only; features After, Paired, or Cosine change
protocol.output: Product of clipped positive score and clipped conditional positive fraction; no manually selected zero cutoff
protocol.candidates: 36 fixed combinations: 3 positive feature families x gamma {0.5,2,8} x alpha {0.01,0.1,1,10}. Same gamma and alpha in both stages.
protocol.selection: Minimum inner group MAE only, using the original/purged inner folds; select independently for each budget
protocol.comparison: Original Change50; all predictions and failure slices retained
protocol.deployment: No model promotion until all gates and leakage checks pass. No individual-sample patching.

Hurdle50.scope: Conditional development interval for saved outer forecasts; does not include new training runs, label error or institution shift.
